```{r}
library(tibble)
library(knitr)

Dados_saude <- tibble::tibble(
  code_health_region = c(11001, 11006),
  name_health_region = c(
    "Vale do Jamari - RO",
    "Cone Sul - RO"
  ),
  code_state = c(11, 11),
  abbrev_state = c("RO", "RO"),
  name_state = c(
    "Rondônia",
    "Rondônia"
  ),
  code_region = c(1, 1),
  name_region = c(
    "Norte",
    "Norte"
  ),
  year = c(2025, 2025),
  geometry = c(
    "POLYGON (...)",
    "POLYGON (...)"
  )
)

kable(Dados_saude)
```
